blocks.value: On the beautiful morning of March 12, 2026, a perfect little miracle made her entrance into the world, bringing immeasurable joy to all who love her.

Born at 6:23 AM at Riverside Birthing Center, Portland, Oregon 
Weighing 8 lbs 2 oz, Measuring 21 inches
Daughter of Emma Rose Fitzgerald and Thomas William Fitzgerald
This tiny angel arrived with ten perfect fingers, ten perfect toes, and a heart full of love that will grow forever.
